entries.17bba2e197bdb66f: Its strengths are that it combines a radio and television broadcasting base serving Niigata Prefecture with diversification into fields beyond broadcasting. As a member of the JNN network, whose key station is TBS Television, Inc., consolidated subsidiary Niigata Hoso has cooperative relationships in news gathering, programming and sales. In the System-related Business, it offers industry-specific services, including contracted development with Niigata as its nearshore development base and contracted medical insurance claims processing. A structure that comprehensively handles broadcasting, IT and real estate management forms the foundation of the group.

entries.9528c6265af3f5f9: Under its management philosophy, 'As an information industry in Niigata, we remain close to the community and continue to contribute to the sustained development of Niigata through solving various issues,' the company states that it strives to provide diversified content and services that are trusted by all stakeholders. Its medium-term management plan, covering fiscal 2026 to fiscal 2028, aims to combine the strengths of its 'Broadcasting and Media,' 'IT System Development' and 'Building Management' businesses, accelerate the creation of group synergies, promote a shift to high value-added business, establish a 'Comprehensive Solutions Business Group,' and realize a transformation to a sustainable, high-profitability structure.
